text:
maria: Heads up — since yesterday evening we've seen egress jitter on dedicated grid allocs for tenant 'creative-ai'. Tail latency spikes from ~35ms -> ~450ms and a couple of preempt events. Not seeing obvious GPU/CPU saturation. Anyone else?

raj: @maria can you paste the allocator logs and the routing mapping? my guess is routing fallback to shared proxy or tag mismatch.

ops-bot: ALERT: egress-flow-anomaly detected for pool=dedicated-grid-eu-west at 2024-11-06T02:14:22Z — spike_rate=4.7σ — incident auto-created (#INC-7452).

maria: here's the alloc log snippet I pulled from the node: 
```
alloc_id=alloc-7f9e3 node=rack42 host=gw-03 egress_queue=102
egress_bytes=1.1GB tail_latency_ms=453 preempt=false
kvcache_hit=0.02 routing_path=proxy->egress-shim->fallback
```

sophie: :eyes: That routing_path looks wrong — it should be proxy->egress-shim->dedicated-egress. Could be a route tag mismatch from last night's rollout.

kevin: I rolled policy `egress-route-v2` at 01:45 UTC for us-west and eu-west. Starting rollback for eu-west now.

kevin: rollback command I'm running: 
```
kubectl apply -f /ops/egress-route-v1.yaml --namespace=infra-routing
```

raj: Also seeing a NIC queue backlog on gw-03 around the same window: 
```
$ ssh gw-03 'tc -s qdisc show dev eth0'
qdisc pfifo_fast 0:... backlog 12.3m packets -> big spike at 01:58
```

maria: @amy can you estimate customer impact and cost delta if we shift those tenants back to shared pool for ~6h? :thinking_face:

amy: short answer—shifting to shared increases per-token cost estimate by ~18% for those tenants but reduces SLO risk. I'll attach a quick billing forecast to the incident.

sophie: Short-term playbook we should run now: 1) rollback routing for eu-west (kevin) 2) drain gw-03 traffic to gw-04 (raj) 3) apply temporary egress-shielding labels on dedicated-grid pools (maria) 4) run a 30m canary and monitor tail percentiles.

maria: doing steps now. I'll update when canary stabilizes. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: #INC-7452 created and assigned to eng-infra oncall.

kevin: rollback applied in eu-west. Watching metrics (prom: infra.egress.tail_latency_p99{pool="dedicated-grid-eu-west"}).

maria: update (1744444500) — canary shows tail latency back to ~28ms, preempt count zero in the window. Keeping shielding labels and monitoring for 1h.

sophie: follow-up: we should add an egress-route dry-run check in CI to catch tag mismatches before rollout. I'll open a tiny PR.

maria: thanks team — closing the immediate thread. I'll write a short postmortem if we surface anything deeper.
